rows.text: scans the qword pointers from qword `rcx+0x250` up to qword `rcx+0x258` (stride 8) and stores to qword `rcx+0x270` the first pointed-to entry whose dword `+4` equals `edx` and whose byte `+0x10` is non-zero, or 0 when none matches

gets an entry from `001BA860(rcx+0x190)`, zeroes its qword `+8`, dwords `+4` and `+0x14` and bytes `+0` and `+0x10`, stores `(dword rcx+0 shifted left 5) + edx` to its dword `+0x18`, and tail-jumps `001B4590(rcx, entry)`
swaps dwords `rcx+0` and `rcx+4` when the first is greater (signed), then swaps dwords `rcx+8` and `rcx+0xC` under the same test

returns when `rcx` is null; otherwise walks the list from `rcx` through qword `+0x60` links and, for every node whose byte `+2` is 1, clears bits 1 and 2 (AND `0xFFF9`) and then sets bits 0 and 3 (OR 9) of word `+0x4E`, stores `0x3F800000` to dword `+0x38` and `0x80` to word `+0x4C`

notes: 00402BF0: `0x3F800000` is written as raw hex because the listing does not decode it (1.0 in IEEE single). No doubts.
